key.name: charge-limit
key.description: 100 = no limit. Charging resumes 5 % below the limit; the phone keeps running from the charger meanwhile.

key.name: adaptive-charging
key.description: Plugged in overnight with an alarm set: hold at adaptive-hold-level and finish charging just before the next alarm.

key.name: adaptive-margin-minutes
key.summary: Finish this many minutes before the alarm

key.name: saver-enabled
key.summary: Battery saver switched on by the user

key.name: saver-auto-level
key.summary: Turn battery saver on automatically at this level (%), 0 = never
key.description: Turns off again when the phone is plugged in.

key.name: saver-cpu-limit
key.summary: Battery saver limits the maximum CPU speed

key.name: saver-cpu-percent
key.summary: Maximum CPU frequency in battery saver (% of each cluster's maximum)

key.name: saver-brightness-cap
key.summary: Maximum screen brightness in battery saver (%), 100 = no cap

key.name: saver-stop-waydroid
key.summary: Battery saver stops the Waydroid (Android) container

key.name: saver-extras
key.summary: Boolean settings ("schema key") switched off while battery saver is on
key.description: Always-on extras such as gesture sensor sampling; restored afterwards unless changed meanwhile.

key.name: saver-dismiss
key.summary: Incremented by the Settings page to turn an automatic battery saver off

key.name: saver-active
key.summary: Battery saver is active (written by fp6-batteryd agent; read-only for others)

key.name: charging-indicator
key.summary: Show charging speed and time to full in the status bar (also on the lock screen)
